deletionInside: a deletion over a charade takes letters from one piece (or takes a whole piece the charade added): the indicator acts on that piece alone, so delete inside the charade, del(piece, letters), and add no piece only to remove it

wrongRole: an indicator is filed on an op of another type (a reversal word on the container, a container word on the anagram, a selection word on the container): put each indicator on the op it signals
bareInitial: a leaf gives the first letter of its word with no selection op: use first<indicator>(word)
